verification.notes: Transcript context at 9:56 attributes the line to a private message read by Owens. Independently, reference works describe the Talmud as the Mishnah plus Gemara, a post-biblical corpus of rabbinic teaching, debate, law, and interpretation central to Rabbinic Judaism. Calling it non-biblical rabbinical interpretation is broadly accurate, though simplified.
